summary: WAVE 2 QA: backend export endpoints (S23) + records product filter (S16) via pytest, and frontend Playwright coverage of Export screen, Product Transactions, Sync waiting, Connection-problem redirect, Settings hub, and nav regression. All 12 pytest cases pass (12/12) and all 6 UI flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: exports.create_export builds the file synchronously inside the request; fine for small seller data but if any single ledger export grows large the request timeout will bite. Consider moving to a background worker with real status polling if row_count > threshold.
storage.py caches session key in module-global _session_key without a lock; benign in single-worker uvicorn but could double-init under concurrent workers. Not blocking.
get_export returns Content-Disposition with filename derived from kind+dates; safe for now (no user-controlled filename), but if kind ever becomes free text add sanitisation.
Product Transactions link, Export ready + download, Sync waiting all have proper data-testid attributes. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Export build+download, Product transactions link+records-list, Sync waiting, Connection-problem redirect to Today, Settings hub Export/Sync links, Nav 6 tabs)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests created several ShopExportJob rows in exports table (non-destructive, no cleanup needed). Blob objects also written to Emergent object storage under prefix myshopedge/exports/{shop_id}/.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wave 2 tests in /app/service/tests/test_exports_wave2.py. Export endpoints synchronous, returned status='ready' immediately with row_count/size_bytes. CSV first-row is header row (checked). XLSX validated by PK zip magic. Idempotency-Key 8-128 chars, tested with 'test-wave2-<random12hex>'. Note the connection-problem page correctly redirects to /today when shop is healthy - this is by design. The Playwright Export test used the default form values (month_summary/xlsx/sales/current-month) rather than typing period 2026-07-01..2026-08-31; the default period still produced a downloadable file, so the flow works end-to-end.
